summary: Frontend retest against live prod backend (https://aged-care-os.emergent.host) as cathy@example.com. KEY CONTACTS CREATE: FIXED — POST /api/participants/{pid}/contacts now returns 200 with new payload {name, kind, phone, is_primary:false}; 'Contact added.' toast shows; contact appears under GP group; expand row reveals phone (tappable), Edit and Remove. CALENDAR CREATE: FIXED — testID='visit-date' wrapper and inner data-testid='visit-date-input' / 'visit-time-input' are now reaching the DOM (verified by querySelector); filling them via Playwright works; POST /api/visits returns 200; 'Appointment added' toast shows; visit appears in day panel and in agenda view; tapping the event opens the composer in Edit Appointment mode with visit-remove visible. extractErrorMessage 422 surfacing: not specifically triggered (no 422 came back this run since payload is now correct). CRITICAL REMAINING ISSUE: Alert.alert() is a no-op on react-native-web in this app. Clicking kc-remove-{id} or visit-remove fires Alert.alert with Keep/Remove buttons, but no native window.confirm dialog is shown, no 'dialog' event fires in Playwright, and NO DELETE request is sent. The Remove button is therefore unreachable from the web UI — affecting BOTH KeyContactsModal.remove (KeyContactsModal.tsx:203-218) and calendar visit-remove (calendar.tsx:207-219). Backend DELETE endpoints themselves work perfectly: confirmed by direct fetch — DELETE /api/visits/{id} and DELETE /api/participants/{pid}/contacts/{id} both returned 200. Test data cleanup: 3 QA visits + 1 QA contact deleted via direct API call. Deprecated packages detected: none new. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. Other warnings (non-blocking): RN 'shadow*'/'pointerEvents' deprecation; Inter-VariableFont.ttf OTS decode failure on web; expo-notifications listener warning.

ui_bugs.issue: On react-native-web, `Alert.alert('Remove …', message, [Keep, Remove])` renders NOTHING — no native confirm, no in-app modal — so the destructive callback is never invoked. Result: clicking kc-remove-{id} or visit-remove on web does not delete (no DELETE network request is sent, no toast, no UI change). Backend DELETE works (verified via direct fetch, returns 200). Fix options: (a) use a platform-aware confirm — `Platform.OS === 'web' ? window.confirm(message) : Alert.alert(...)`; (b) replace with a cross-platform custom modal (matches the rest of the app's design). Reference: src/components/KeyContactsModal.tsx:203-218; app/calendar.tsx:207-219.

react_native_issues.issue: Alert.alert is not implemented on react-native-web — the 2-button (Keep/Remove) confirmation never appears, so any destructive flow that depends on it is broken on web. Affects KeyContactsModal.tsx:203 and calendar.tsx:207. Use Platform.OS==='web' ? window.confirm(...) : Alert.alert(...) or a cross-platform custom modal.

action_items: Replace Alert.alert(...) confirm step with a cross-platform confirm — easiest fix: `const ok = Platform.OS === 'web' ? window.confirm('Remove contact?') : await new Promise(r => Alert.alert('Remove contact?', msg, [{text:'Keep', onPress:()=>r(false)}, {text:'Remove', style:'destructive', onPress:()=>r(true)}]));` then `if (ok) await api.delete(...)`. Apply in BOTH KeyContactsModal.tsx (remove fn, line ~203) AND calendar.tsx (remove fn, line ~207). This unblocks the full CRUD flow on web.
After the Alert.alert fix lands, re-run the delete leg of both flows (kc-remove-{id} → confirm → DELETE 200 → toast; visit-remove → confirm → DELETE 200 → toast).
Optional: address RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow* / pointerEvents) and the Inter font decode failure for a cleaner console.

rca_of_issue: Alert.alert no-op on react-native-web: react-native-web's Alert export is a stub that does not render the buttons array. When KeyContactsModal.remove or calendar.remove call `Alert.alert('Remove …', msg, [{text:'Keep',style:'cancel'}, {text:'Remove',style:'destructive',onPress: async () => { await api.delete(...) }}])`, nothing visible happens on web and the destructive onPress is never invoked. Reproduction: log in as cathy@example.com → /today → Key Contacts → add a contact → expand → tap Remove → nothing happens, no DELETE request fires. Or: /calendar → Add Appointment → save → tap the event card → tap Remove in composer → nothing happens. Verified the backend DELETE works by issuing the requests directly via fetch from the page (all returned 200). Mitigation: branch on Platform.OS — on web, use `window.confirm(msg)` (returns boolean); on native, keep Alert.alert. Better long-term: a single cross-platform `useConfirm()` hook that renders a styled modal.
